The '''Peluchia system''' was located in the [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Peluchian]] style of personal grooming.<ref name="Otherspace">[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Peluchian]]|system=Peluchia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Peluchia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first introduced in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine. The article placed it in the [[Altor sector]] and<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> erroneously<ref name="Shantipole">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref> claimed that it was referenced in the<ref name="Twinkle" /> [[1988]]<ref name="Shantipole" /> roleplaying adventure ''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle" /> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], subsequently the Peluchia system in grid square Q-11,<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by placing the system in the Kurost [[Sector/Legends|sector]] instead.<ref name="EAOC" />
